page.overview:
What is Grace?

The Grace are Great Old Ones from the fictional universe of Doctor Who by Big Finish Productions.

The Grace are a benevolent group of Great Old Ones who created the Key to Time. The Black and White Guardians are their agents. They exist outside of time and space, in a state of non-existence. This collective works at keeping the universe together, and when necessary enters reality to prevent its collapse. Beings which are too big to enter normal time and space, the Doctor imagined them as "big, peaceful, pan-dimensional creatures with enormous power". They are in fact entities who can stop time for brief periods and crush the Doctor with a thought. (: The Chaos Pool)

In their native realm, the Grace appear as impish boneless creatures. (: The Prisoner's Dilemma)

Despite their association with the Mythos as putative Great Old Ones, their goodness puts them at odds with the cosmicism of Lovecraft and aligns them more with the benevolent Elder Gods of the Derleth version of the Mythos.
